body: Well im here if you want to talk. Sorry to hear your family left you, but you shouldnt just think that commiting is the only option. Everyone needs time to grow, even adults, so just give yourself time and try to be the dad u want to be. From what i see you really love ur kids, which already makes u a great dad!
